name: kumo-app
description: Kumo AI - Android App (Capacitor wrapper for KumoAI web app)

scripts.copy:web: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path www) { Remove-Item www -Recurse -Force }; Copy-Item -Path ../KumoAI/dist -Destination www -Recurse"
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew assembleRelease
